source: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 11: permissible stress design of structural timber. Species and strength groups (Sec 11.4.1, Tables 6.11.1 and 6.11.9), grade and durability factors (Sec 11.5.2), modification factors K1 to K7 (Sec 11.5.3, 11.6.6), flexural members (Sec 11.6.6), solid, box and spaced columns (Sec 11.6.7), combined stresses (Sec 11.6.8), nailed joints (Sec 11.7), bolted joints (Sec 11.9), connector and disc-dowel joints (Sec 11.10), nail and screw holding (Sec 11.18).

sources.groups: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.5.1, Table 6.11.9 (gazette part 2 p. 296): inside values; outside and wet 5/6 and 2/3 of them (note 1). Group A shear along the grain is printed 15, an evident misprint for 1.5: the conservative 1.5 is used.
sources.species: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.11.1 (pp. 285-287): Grade I permissible stresses by species and location, E (all locations), durability class, treatability grade and seasoning class. Rows with an evident misprint or a missing value carry no stresses (design them by strength group); botanical names as printed.
sources.grades: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.5.2 (p. 295): select grade 1.16, grade II 0.84 (all stresses except E)
sources.lowDurability: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.5.2 (p. 295): low durability timber (Table 6.11.1 durability class III, average life below 60 months) on outside locations, x 0.80
sources.slopeOfGrain: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.5.3.1, Table 6.11.10 (p. 296): K1 for ungraded timber, interpolated. The posts and columns value at 1 in 14 is printed 0.8 (below 0.82 at 1 in 12); the printed value is kept as the conservative one.
sources.duration: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.5.3.2, Table 6.11.11 (p. 297): K2; the shortest duration load of a combination governs (11.5.3.2.2); K2 also on E for columns (11.5.3.2.1) and on fastener loads (11.5.3.2.3)
sources.column: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.6.7.1, Eqs 6.11.9-6.11.11 (p. 305): S/d up to 11 short; intermediate fcp [1 - (1/3) (S/(K8 d))^4]; long 0.329 E/(S/d)^2; S/d at most 50. K8 is printed 0.584 sqrt(E/fcp) (Sec 11.3, p. 282); 0.702 is the value at which Eqs 6.11.10 and 6.11.11 meet and the more conservative one (owner decision 2026-11-01).
sources.boxColumn: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.6.7.2, Eqs 6.11.12-6.11.14 (p. 306): ratio S/sqrt(d1^2 + d2^2), short below 8; K9 = (pi/2) sqrt(U E/(5 q fcp)) (Sec 11.3, p. 283) = 0.7025 sqrt(U E/(q fcp)); U and q by plank thickness. Eq 6.11.13 is printed without K9 in the ratio; read with K9, as the classification (b) gives.
sources.spacedColumn: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.6.7.3, Eqs 6.11.15-6.11.16 (p. 307): restraint factor 2.5 (fasteners at S/20 from the end) or 3 (S/10 to S/20); long 0.329 E x factor/(S/d)^2; S/d of each member at most 80. K10 is printed 0.584 sqrt(2.5 E/fcp) (p. 283); 0.702 sqrt(factor E/fcp) is used, as for K8, where the two formulas meet (conservative).
sources.formFactors: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.6.6.4(b)-(d), Eqs 6.11.3-6.11.4 (p. 299): K4 = 0.8 + 0.8 y ((D^2 + 89400)/(D^2 + 55000) - 1), y printed p1^2 + (6 - 8 p1 + 3 p1^2)(1 - q1) + q1; the product p1^2 (6 - 8 p1 + 3 p1^2)(1 - q1) + q1 is used (smaller y, the conservative reading). K5 = 1.18 (solid circular), K6 = 1.414 (square loaded on the diagonal).
sources.flexure: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.6.6.5-11.6.6.6.1 (pp. 299-300): width at least 50 mm and span/50; depth over 3 x width or span over 50 x width needs lateral restraint at most 50 x width apart; Sec 11.6.6.7.4(a) (p. 301): notches at most D/5 deep and within span/6 of the support; Sec 11.6.4.3 (p. 298): at most a quarter of the section; Sec 11.6.6.8.1 (p. 302): bearing at least 75 mm
sources.bearing: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.6.6.8.3, Table 6.11.13 (pp. 303-304): K7 for bearings shorter than 150 mm at least 75 mm from the end; at the ends of a member K7 = 1; Eq 6.11.7 for stress at an angle to the grain
sources.concentratedNearSupport: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.6.6.7.3(c), Table 6.11.12 (p. 301): reduction factor of concentrated loads at 1.5D or less (printed LSD), 2D, 2.5D and 3D or more from the support, interpolated; read as the share of the load removed
sources.deflection: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.6.6.9 (p. 304): span/360 supporting brittle finishes, span/240 otherwise, cantilevers 1/150 of the free length; 11.6.6.9.2: twice the dead load for the long-term effect on E
sources.nails: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.7 (pp. 308-310), Tables 6.11.2-6.11.3 (pp. 290-291, permissible lateral strength in double shear, printed in N x 10^2, here in N), Table 6.11.14 (p. 309, multiples of the shank diameter n); the 3.55 mm values also hold for 4 mm x 100 mm nails (Table 6.11.2 note); Sec 11.8.3.2 (p. 316): clenched nails 20% more
sources.bolts: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.9 (pp. 317-322), Table 6.11.16 (p. 319, percentages of the compressive stress by t'/d3; the parallel column ends at 10), Table 6.11.17 (p. 319), Eqs 6.11.19-6.11.21 (p. 322): P = fcp a lambda1, R = fcn a lambda2 df, F = P R/(P sin^2 + R cos^2); single shear half the double shear load (11.9.2.2)
sources.connectors: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 11.10.1-11.10.2 (pp. 322-323): split rings (main 57 mm, side 38 mm, loaded edge at least D, end at least 1.75 D); disc dowels (25-35 mm thick, 50-150 mm across, diameter 3.25-3.5 x thickness, edge 12-20 mm, end at least d in tension and 0.75 d in compression); Figure 6.11.9: pi d^2/4 s = d t/2 c
